ExternalReference.Architecture: ParserFirstCallInit registers #cuinfobox; PHP schema registry and renderer produce HTML. It is not a Lua/Scribunto implementation.

Implementation.LegacyAdapter: Well-formed bounded <infobox> title/image/caption/data/group markup is converted to an internal typed token; DTDs, external entities, excessive XML, unknown elements, panels, navigation, and arbitrary attributes receive typed diagnostics and remain on the existing unsupported path.
Implementation.RenderingBoundary: Typed tokens are rendered by the existing bounded inline parser. Labels, attributes, links, media, and text use the existing allow-list and HTML encoding path.
Implementation.SchemaInterchange: Versioned schemaVersion=1 JSON supports bounded serialization/deserialization of immutable schema records; registry validation enforces maximum schema/field/group/alias counts, inheritance depth, duplicate detection, allowlisted layouts, alias targets, missing parts, and inheritance-cycle rejection. PHP is never executed.
SupportedSchemaFeatures: nested dotted and bracket field paths
PreservedSecurity: No arbitrary URLs or external fetches
Existing input, field, parse, expansion, diagnostic, and output budgets remain in force
